import syntax = "./grammar_parser.qui"

class Node(string symbol, string mark, int[] children)
class Trace(int step, string stack, string input, string action)
class Event(int step, string kind, string symbol, string token, int position)
class Parsed(Node[] tree, Trace[] trace, int[] left_parse, Event[] events, int[] counts)

Parsed parse(string[] tokens, int[] positions, string start, string[] order, string[] terminals, int[][] choices, string[][] follow, string[][] production_rhs, string[] production_notations)
    input := tokens.append("$")
    locations := positions.append(int(#tokens) + 1)
    tree := [Node(start, "", [])]
    stack := ["$", start]
    stack_nodes := [-1, 0]
    Trace[] trace := []
    int[] left_parse := []
    Event[] events := []
    counts := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    columns := terminals.append("$")
    cursor := 0
    step := 0
    while true
        step += 1
        last := int(#stack) - 1
        top := stack[last]
        node := stack_nodes[last]
        token := input[cursor]
        before_stack := stack.join(" ")
        before_input := input[cursor:<int(#input)].join(" ")
        if int(#stack) > counts[5]
            counts[5] = int(#stack)
        action := ""
        kind := ""
        terminate := false
        if top == "$" and token == "$"
            action = "accept"
            terminate = true
        elif top == "$"
            action = "error: skip {token}"
            kind = "skip"
        elif not syntax.is_nonterminal(top)
            stack = stack[0:<last]
            stack_nodes = stack_nodes[0:<last]
            if top == token
                action = "match {token}"
                cursor += 1
                counts[1] += 1
            else
                action = "error: missing {top}"
                kind = "missing"
                tree[node].mark = "missing"
        else
            lhs := syntax.index_of(order, top)
            column := syntax.index_of(columns, token)
            number := choices[lhs][column]
            if number > 0
                action = "predict {number}: {production_notations[number - 1]}"
                left_parse = left_parse.append(number)
                counts[0] += 1
                stack = stack[0:<last]
                stack_nodes = stack_nodes[0:<last]
                rhs := production_rhs[number - 1]
                if #rhs == 0
                    child := int(#tree)
                    tree = tree.append(Node("%empty", "", []))
                    tree[node].children = [child]
                else
                    int[] children := []
                    for symbol := rhs[]
                        children = children.append(int(#tree))
                        tree = tree.append(Node(symbol, "", []))
                    tree[node].children = children
                    for child := children[::-1][]
                        stack = stack.append(tree[child].symbol)
                        stack_nodes = stack_nodes.append(child)
            elif token == "$" or syntax.index_of(follow[lhs], token) >= 0
                action = "error: pop {top}"
                kind = "pop"
                tree[node].mark = "error"
                stack = stack[0:<last]
                stack_nodes = stack_nodes[0:<last]
            else
                action = "error: skip {token}"
                kind = "skip"
        if kind != ""
            events = events.append(Event(step, kind, top, token, locations[cursor]))
            count_index := if kind == "skip" then 2 elif kind == "pop" then 3 else 4
            counts[count_index] += 1
            if kind == "skip"
                cursor += 1
        trace = trace.append(Trace(step, before_stack, before_input, action))
        if terminate
            break
    return Parsed(tree, trace, left_parse, events, counts)

import syntax = "./grammar_parser.qui"

bool merge(string[] &target, string[] values)
    changed := false
    for value := values[]
        if syntax.index_of(target, value) < 0
            target = target.append(value)
            changed = true
    return changed

string[] terminal_order(string[] values)
    string[] result := []
    end_marker := false
    for value := values.sorted()[]
        if value == "$"
            end_marker = true
        elif syntax.index_of(result, value) < 0
            result = result.append(value)
    return if end_marker then result.append("$") else result

string[] known_terminals(string[][][] rules)
    string[] result := []
    for alternatives := rules[]
        for rhs := alternatives[]
            for symbol := rhs[]
                if not syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol) and syntax.index_of(result, symbol) < 0
                    result = result.append(symbol)
    return result.sorted()

class Sequence(string[] first, bool nullable)
class Sets(bool[] nullable, string[][] first, string[][] follow, int[] passes, string[] terminals)

Sequence sequence(string[] symbols, string[] order, bool[] nullable, string[][] first)
    string[] result := []
    for symbol := symbols[]
        if not syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol)
            merge(&result, [symbol])
            return Sequence(result, false)
        index := syntax.index_of(order, symbol)
        merge(&result, first[index])
        if not nullable[index]
            return Sequence(result, false)
    return Sequence(result, true)

Sets analyze(string[] order, string[][][] rules, string start)
    nullable := [for i := (0:<int(#order))[] then false]
    string[][] first := [for i := (0:<int(#order))[] then []]
    string[][] follow := [for i := (0:<int(#order))[] then []]
    passes := [0, 0, 0]
    changed := true
    while changed
        changed = false
        passes[0] += 1
        for: lhs < int(#order)
            if nullable[lhs]
                continue
            for rhs := rules[lhs][]
                empty := true
                for symbol := rhs[]
                    if not syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol) or not nullable[syntax.index_of(order, symbol)]
                        empty = false
                        break
                if empty
                    nullable[lhs] = true
                    changed = true
                    break
    changed = true
    while changed
        changed = false
        passes[1] += 1
        for: lhs < int(#order)
            for rhs := rules[lhs][]
                values := sequence(rhs, order, nullable, first)
                if merge(&first[lhs], values.first)
                    changed = true
    follow[syntax.index_of(order, start)] = ["$"]
    changed = true
    while changed
        changed = false
        passes[2] += 1
        for: lhs < int(#order)
            for rhs := rules[lhs][]
                for: position < int(#rhs)
                    symbol := rhs[position]
                    if syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol)
                        index := syntax.index_of(order, symbol)
                        values := sequence(rhs[position + 1:<int(#rhs)], order, nullable, first)
                        if merge(&follow[index], values.first)
                            changed = true
                        if values.nullable and merge(&follow[index], follow[lhs])
                            changed = true
    return Sets(nullable, first, follow, passes, known_terminals(rules))

int index_of<T>(T[] values, T target)
    for: i < int(#values)
        if values[i] == target
            return i
    return -1

bool is_nonterminal(string symbol)
    return #symbol >= 2 and symbol[0] == "<" and symbol[int(#symbol) - 1] == ">"

string alternative(string[] symbols)
    return if #symbols == 0 then "%empty" else symbols.join(" ")

string production(string lhs, string[] rhs)
    return "{lhs} -> {alternative(rhs)}"

bool letter(string character)
    int code := character.codepoints()[0]
    return 65 <= code <= 90 or 97 <= code <= 122

bool word_character(string character)
    int code := character.codepoints()[0]
    return letter(character) or 48 <= code <= 57 or character == "_"

class Grammar(string[] order, string[][][] rules, string start)
class Token(string kind, string value, int start, int finish)
class Line(string kind, string lhs, string[][] alternatives, string[] words, int column)
class Source(Grammar grammar, string[] diagnostics, string[] declared, bool has_declarations, string[] word_names, int[] word_lines)

Token[] lex(string line)
    Token[] tokens := []
    cursor := 0
    count := int(#line)
    while cursor < count
        character := line[cursor]
        if character == " "
            cursor += 1
            continue
        if character == "#"
            break
        start := cursor
        kind := "invalid"
        value := character
        if character == "<"
            end := cursor + 1
            if end < count and letter(line[end])
                end += 1
                while end < count and word_character(line[end])
                    end += 1
                if end < count and line[end] == ">"
                    kind = "nonterminal"
                    cursor = end + 1
                    value = line[start:<cursor]
        elif character == DQ
            end := cursor + 1
            while end < count and line[end] != " " and line[end] != DQ
                end += 1
            if end > cursor + 1 and end < count and line[end] == DQ
                kind = "terminal"
                value = line[cursor + 1:<end]
                cursor = end + 1
        elif letter(character)
            cursor += 1
            while cursor < count and word_character(line[cursor])
                cursor += 1
            kind = "word"
            value = line[start:<cursor]
        elif cursor + 3 <= count and line[cursor:<cursor + 3] == "::="
            kind = "definition"
            value = "::="
            cursor += 3
        elif character == "|"
            kind = "separator"
            cursor += 1
        elif character == "%"
            end := cursor + 1
            while end < count and letter(line[end])
                end += 1
            name := line[cursor + 1:<end]
            if name == "empty" or name == "start" or name == "token"
                kind = "directive"
                value = "%" + name
                cursor = end
        if kind == "invalid"
            cursor = start + 1
        tokens = tokens.append(Token(kind, value, start + 1, cursor))
        if kind == "invalid"
            break
    return tokens

int error_column(Token[] tokens, int cursor)
    return if cursor < int(#tokens) then tokens[cursor].start else tokens[-1].finish + 1

Line parse_alternatives(Token[] tokens, int cursor, string kind, string lhs)
    string[][] alternatives := []
    while true
        if cursor >= int(#tokens)
            return Line("invalid", "", [], [], error_column(tokens, cursor))
        string[] rhs := []
        if tokens[cursor].kind == "directive" and tokens[cursor].value == "%empty"
            cursor += 1
        elif tokens[cursor].kind == "nonterminal" or tokens[cursor].kind == "terminal" or tokens[cursor].kind == "word"
            while cursor < int(#tokens) and (tokens[cursor].kind == "nonterminal" or tokens[cursor].kind == "terminal" or tokens[cursor].kind == "word")
                rhs = rhs.append(tokens[cursor].value)
                cursor += 1
        else
            return Line("invalid", "", [], [], error_column(tokens, cursor))
        alternatives = alternatives.append(rhs)
        if cursor == int(#tokens)
            return Line(kind, lhs, alternatives, [], 0)
        if tokens[cursor].kind != "separator"
            return Line("invalid", "", [], [], error_column(tokens, cursor))
        cursor += 1

Line parse_line(Token[] tokens)
    if #tokens == 0
        return Line("blank", "", [], [], 0)
    first := tokens[0]
    if first.kind == "nonterminal"
        if #tokens < 2 or tokens[1].kind != "definition"
            return Line("invalid", "", [], [], error_column(tokens, 1))
        return parse_alternatives(tokens, 2, "rule", first.value)
    if first.kind == "separator"
        return parse_alternatives(tokens, 1, "continuation", "")
    if first.kind == "directive" and first.value == "%start"
        if #tokens < 2 or tokens[1].kind != "nonterminal"
            return Line("invalid", "", [], [], error_column(tokens, 1))
        if #tokens > 2
            return Line("invalid", "", [], [], error_column(tokens, 2))
        return Line("start", tokens[1].value, [], [], 0)
    if first.kind == "directive" and first.value == "%token"
        if #tokens < 2
            return Line("invalid", "", [], [], error_column(tokens, 1))
        string[] words := []
        for: 1 <= i < int(#tokens)
            if tokens[i].kind != "word"
                return Line("invalid", "", [], [], error_column(tokens, i))
            words = words.append(tokens[i].value)
        return Line("declaration", "", [], words, 0)
    return Line("invalid", "", [], [], first.start)

Source parse(string[] lines)
    grammar := Grammar([], [], "")
    string[] diagnostics := []
    string[] declared := []
    has_declarations := false
    string[] word_names := []
    int[] word_lines := []
    attached := -1
    for: number < int(#lines)
        tokens := lex(lines[number])
        parsed := parse_line(tokens)
        if parsed.kind == "invalid"
            diagnostics = diagnostics.append("line {number + 1}: syntax error at column {parsed.column}")
            attached = -1
        elif parsed.kind == "start"
            if grammar.start != ""
                diagnostics = diagnostics.append("line {number + 1}: duplicate %start")
            else
                grammar.start = parsed.lhs
            attached = -1
        elif parsed.kind == "declaration"
            has_declarations = true
            for name := parsed.words[]
                if index_of(declared, name) < 0
                    declared = declared.append(name)
            attached = -1
        elif parsed.kind != "blank"
            if parsed.kind == "rule"
                attached = index_of(grammar.order, parsed.lhs)
                if attached < 0
                    attached = int(#grammar.order)
                    grammar.order = grammar.order.append(parsed.lhs)
                    grammar.rules = grammar.rules.append([])
            elif attached < 0
                diagnostics = diagnostics.append("line {number + 1}: continuation without a rule")
            if attached >= 0
                for token := tokens[]
                    if token.kind == "word" and index_of(word_names, token.value) < 0
                        word_names = word_names.append(token.value)
                        word_lines = word_lines.append(number + 1)
                for rhs := parsed.alternatives[]
                    if index_of(grammar.rules[attached], rhs) >= 0
                        diagnostics = diagnostics.append("line {number + 1}: duplicate alternative {production(grammar.order[attached], rhs)}")
                    else
                        grammar.rules[attached] = grammar.rules[attached].append(rhs)
    if grammar.start == ""
        grammar.start = grammar.order[0]
    return Source(grammar, diagnostics, declared, has_declarations, word_names, word_lines)

import syntax = "./grammar_parser.qui"
import analysis = "./first_follow.qui"

class Production(int number, int lhs, string[] rhs, string notation)
class Conflict(int lhs, int token, int[] numbers, string kind, int chosen)
class Table(Production[] productions, string[][] predict, string[][] reasons, int[][][] cells, int[][] choices, Conflict[] conflicts)

Production[] number_productions(string[] order, string[][][] rules)
    Production[] result := []
    for: lhs < int(#order)
        for rhs := rules[lhs][]
            result = result.append(Production(int(#result) + 1, lhs, rhs, syntax.production(order[lhs], rhs)))
    return result

Table build(string[] order, string[][][] rules, bool[] nullable, string[][] first, string[][] follow, string[] terminals)
    productions := number_productions(order, rules)
    columns := terminals.append("$")
    string[][] predict := []
    string[][] reasons := []
    int[][][] cells := [for i := (0:<int(#order))[] then [for j := (0:<int(#columns))[] then []]]
    choices := [for i := (0:<int(#order))[] then [for j := (0:<int(#columns))[] then 0]]
    for production := productions[]
        values := analysis.sequence(production.rhs, order, nullable, first)
        tokens := values.first
        if values.nullable
            analysis.merge(&tokens, follow[production.lhs])
        tokens = analysis.terminal_order(tokens)
        string[] token_reasons := []
        for token := tokens[]
            token_reasons = token_reasons.append(if syntax.index_of(values.first, token) >= 0 then "FIRST" else "FOLLOW")
            column := syntax.index_of(columns, token)
            cells[production.lhs][column] = cells[production.lhs][column].append(production.number)
        predict = predict.append(tokens)
        reasons = reasons.append(token_reasons)
    Conflict[] conflicts := []
    for: lhs < int(#order)
        for: column < int(#columns)
            numbers := cells[lhs][column]
            if #numbers == 0
                continue
            chosen := numbers[0]
            has_first := false
            has_follow := false
            for number := numbers[]
                index := syntax.index_of(predict[number - 1], columns[column])
                if reasons[number - 1][index] == "FIRST"
                    if not has_first
                        chosen = number
                    has_first = true
                else
                    has_follow = true
            choices[lhs][column] = chosen
            if #numbers > 1
                kind := if has_first then (if has_follow then "FIRST/FOLLOW" else "FIRST/FIRST") else "FOLLOW/FOLLOW"
                conflicts = conflicts.append(Conflict(lhs, column, numbers, kind, chosen))
    return Table(productions, predict, reasons, cells, choices, conflicts)

import syntax = "./grammar_parser.qui"
import transform = "./transform.qui"
import analysis = "./first_follow.qui"
import tables = "./ll_table.qui"
import driver = "./driver.qui"

string[] read_lines(string path)
    string content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    result := content.split(NL)
    return result[0:<int(#result) - 1]

string joined<T>(string heading, T[] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then "{value}"]
    return if #fields == 0 then heading else heading + " " + fields.join(" ")

string yes_no(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

bool less(int[] first, int[] second)
    for: i < int(#first)
        if first[i] != second[i]
            return first[i] < second[i]
    return false

string[] check_declarations(syntax.Source source)
    string[] result := []
    if source.has_declarations
        for name := source.word_names.sorted()[]
            if syntax.index_of(source.declared, name) < 0
                index := syntax.index_of(source.word_names, name)
                result = result.append("undeclared terminal {name} at line {source.word_lines[index]}")
    return result

bool[] reachable(syntax.Grammar source)
    initial := syntax.index_of(source.order, source.start)
    found := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then i == initial]
    queue := [initial]
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#queue)
        lhs := queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for rhs := source.rules[lhs][]
            for symbol := rhs[]
                index := syntax.index_of(source.order, symbol)
                if index >= 0 and not found[index]
                    found[index] = true
                    queue = queue.append(index)
    return found

syntax.Grammar filtered(syntax.Grammar source, bool[] keep)
    string[] order := []
    string[][][] rules := []
    for: lhs < int(#source.order)
        if keep[lhs]
            order = order.append(source.order[lhs])
            rules = rules.append(source.rules[lhs])
    return syntax.Grammar(order, rules, source.start)

void remove_alternatives(syntax.Grammar &model, string[] removed, string reason, string[] &diagnostics)
    for: lhs < int(#model.order)
        string[][] retained := []
        for rhs := model.rules[lhs][]
            first := ""
            for symbol := rhs[]
                if syntax.index_of(removed, symbol) >= 0
                    first = symbol
                    break
            if first != ""
                diagnostics = diagnostics.append("removed {syntax.production(model.order[lhs], rhs)} ({reason} {first})")
            else
                retained = retained.append(rhs)
        model.rules[lhs] = retained

class Cleaned(syntax.Grammar model, string[] diagnostics)

Cleaned clean(syntax.Grammar source)
    model := source
    string[] diagnostics := []
    string[] undefined_inner := []
    for alternatives := model.rules[]
        for rhs := alternatives[]
            for symbol := rhs[]
                if syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol) and syntax.index_of(model.order, symbol) < 0
                    name := symbol[1:<int(#symbol) - 1]
                    if syntax.index_of(undefined_inner, name) < 0
                        undefined_inner = undefined_inner.append(name)
    undefined := [for name := undefined_inner.sorted()[] then "<{name}>"]
    for name := undefined[]
        diagnostics = diagnostics.append("undefined nonterminal {name}")
    remove_alternatives(&model, undefined, "undefined", &diagnostics)
    productive := [for i := (0:<int(#model.order))[] then false]
    changed := true
    while changed
        changed = false
        for: lhs < int(#model.order)
            if productive[lhs]
                continue
            for rhs := model.rules[lhs][]
                valid := true
                for symbol := rhs[]
                    if syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol) and not productive[syntax.index_of(model.order, symbol)]
                        valid = false
                        break
                if valid
                    productive[lhs] = true
                    changed = true
                    break
    string[] unproductive := []
    for: lhs < int(#model.order)
        if not productive[lhs]
            unproductive = unproductive.append(model.order[lhs])
            diagnostics = diagnostics.append("unproductive nonterminal {model.order[lhs]}")
    model = filtered(model, productive)
    remove_alternatives(&model, unproductive, "unproductive", &diagnostics)
    reached := reachable(model)
    for: lhs < int(#model.order)
        if not reached[lhs]
            diagnostics = diagnostics.append("unreachable nonterminal {model.order[lhs]}")
    return Cleaned(filtered(model, reached), diagnostics)

string[] left_recursion(syntax.Grammar source)
    string[] diagnostics := []
    for: initial < int(#source.order)
        queue := [initial]
        visited := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then i == initial]
        parents := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then -1]
        cursor := 0
        found := -1
        while cursor < int(#queue) and found < 0
            lhs := queue[cursor]
            cursor += 1
            for rhs := source.rules[lhs][]
                if #rhs == 0
                    continue
                symbol := rhs[0]
                if symbol == source.order[initial]
                    found = lhs
                    break
                next := syntax.index_of(source.order, symbol)
                if next >= 0 and not visited[next]
                    visited[next] = true
                    parents[next] = lhs
                    queue = queue.append(next)
        if found >= 0
            path := [source.order[initial]]
            current := found
            while current != initial
                path = [source.order[current]].concat(path)
                current = parents[current]
            path = [source.order[initial]].concat(path)
            diagnostics = diagnostics.append("left recursion: {path.join(" -> ")}")
    return diagnostics

class Pruned(syntax.Grammar model, string[] log, string[] diagnostics)

Pruned prune(syntax.Grammar source)
    reached := reachable(source)
    string[] log := []
    string[] diagnostics := []
    for: lhs < int(#source.order)
        if not reached[lhs]
            log = log.append("remove unreachable {source.order[lhs]}")
            diagnostics = diagnostics.append("unreachable after transformation {source.order[lhs]}")
    return Pruned(filtered(source, reached), log, diagnostics)

string[] unused_declarations(syntax.Source source, syntax.Grammar final)
    known := analysis.known_terminals(final.rules)
    string[] result := []
    if source.has_declarations
        for name := source.declared.sorted()[]
            if syntax.index_of(known, name) < 0
                result = result.append("unused token {name}")
    return result

string summary(syntax.Grammar source)
    productions := 0
    empty := 0
    unit := 0
    for alternatives := source.rules[]
        for rhs := alternatives[]
            productions += 1
            if #rhs == 0
                empty += 1
            if #rhs == 1 and syntax.is_nonterminal(rhs[0])
                unit += 1
    return "start={source.start} nonterminals={#source.order} terminals={#analysis.known_terminals(source.rules)} productions={productions} empty={empty} unit={unit}"

string[] listing(syntax.Grammar source, bool numbered)
    string[] result := []
    count := 0
    total := int(#tables.number_productions(source.order, source.rules))
    width := int(#"{total}")
    for: lhs < int(#source.order)
        for: index < int(#source.rules[lhs])
            count += 1
            name := source.order[lhs]
            string prefix := if index == 0 then "{name} -> " else " " * #name + " | "
            if numbered
                prefix = " " * nat(width - int(#"{count}")) + "{count}  " + prefix
            result = result.append(prefix + syntax.alternative(source.rules[lhs][index]))
    return result

string[] grammar_report(syntax.Grammar cleaned, syntax.Grammar recursion, syntax.Grammar factored, syntax.Grammar final, string[] recursion_log, string[] factor_log, string[] final_log)
    string[] result := ["== cleaned grammar ==", summary(cleaned)].concat(listing(cleaned, false))
    titles := ["left recursion elimination", "left factoring", "final grammar"]
    stages := [recursion, factored, final]
    logs := [recursion_log, factor_log, final_log]
    for: stage < 3
        result = result.append("").append("== {titles[stage]} ==")
        result = result.concat(if #logs[stage] == 0 then ["none"] else logs[stage])
        result = result.append(summary(stages[stage])).concat(listing(stages[stage], stage == 2))
    result = result.append("").append("== cross reference ==")
    string[] symbols := final.order.concat(analysis.known_terminals(final.rules))
    tables.Production[] productions := tables.number_productions(final.order, final.rules)
    for symbol := symbols[]
        numbers := [for production := productions[] if syntax.index_of(production.rhs, symbol) >= 0 then production.number]
        string name := if syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol) then symbol else DQ + symbol + DQ
        result = result.append(if #numbers == 0 then "{name} not used" else joined("{name} used in", numbers))
    return result

class Score(int length, int height, bool valid)

Score sequence_score(string[] symbols, string[] order, int[][] scores)
    length := 0
    height := 0
    for symbol := symbols[]
        if syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol)
            index := syntax.index_of(order, symbol)
            if scores[index][0] < 0
                return Score(0, 0, false)
            length += scores[index][0]
            if scores[index][1] > height
                height = scores[index][1]
        else
            length += 1
    return Score(length, height + 1, true)

string[] expand_sentence(string symbol, string[] order, string[][] selected, string[][] &memo, bool[] &ready)
    if not syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol)
        return [symbol]
    index := syntax.index_of(order, symbol)
    if not ready[index]
        string[] value := []
        for child := selected[index][]
            value = value.concat(expand_sentence(child, order, selected, &memo, &ready))
        memo[index] = value
        ready[index] = true
    return memo[index]

class Shortest(int[][] scores, string[][] sentences)

Shortest shortest(syntax.Grammar source)
    int[][] scores := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then [-1, -1]]
    changed := true
    while changed
        changed = false
        for: lhs < int(#source.order)
            for rhs := source.rules[lhs][]
                score := sequence_score(rhs, source.order, scores)
                key := [score.length, score.height]
                if score.valid and (scores[lhs][0] < 0 or less(key, scores[lhs]))
                    scores[lhs] = key
                    changed = true
    string[][] selected := []
    for: lhs < int(#source.order)
        string[] choice := []
        for rhs := source.rules[lhs][]
            score := sequence_score(rhs, source.order, scores)
            if score.valid and [score.length, score.height] == scores[lhs]
                choice = rhs
                break
        selected = selected.append(choice)
    string[][] sentences := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then []]
    ready := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then false]
    for lhs := source.order[]
        expand_sentence(lhs, source.order, selected, &sentences, &ready)
    return Shortest(scores, sentences)

string[] sentence(string[] symbols, string[] order, string[][] sentences)
    string[] result := []
    for symbol := symbols[]
        result = result.concat(if syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol) then sentences[syntax.index_of(order, symbol)] else [symbol])
    return result

void build_context(int index, string[] order, int[][] parents, string[][] bodies, string[][] sentences, string[][] &prefixes, string[][] &suffixes, bool[] &ready)
    if ready[index]
        return
    number := parents[index][0]
    position := parents[index][1]
    lhs := parents[index][2]
    build_context(lhs, order, parents, bodies, sentences, &prefixes, &suffixes, &ready)
    rhs := bodies[number - 1]
    prefixes[index] = prefixes[lhs].concat(sentence(rhs[0:<position], order, sentences))
    suffixes[index] = sentence(rhs[position + 1:<int(#rhs)], order, sentences).concat(suffixes[lhs])
    ready[index] = true

class Contexts(string[][] prefixes, string[][] suffixes)

Contexts contexts(syntax.Grammar source, int[][] scores, string[][] sentences, tables.Production[] productions)
    int[][] costs := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then [-1, -1]]
    int[][] parents := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then [-1, -1, -1]]
    start := syntax.index_of(source.order, source.start)
    costs[start] = [0, 0]
    changed := true
    while changed
        changed = false
        for production := productions[]
            lhs := production.lhs
            if costs[lhs][0] < 0
                continue
            for: position < int(#production.rhs)
                symbol := production.rhs[position]
                if not syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol) or symbol == source.start
                    continue
                index := syntax.index_of(source.order, symbol)
                string[] outside := production.rhs[0:<position].concat(production.rhs[position + 1:<int(#production.rhs)])
                score := sequence_score(outside, source.order, scores)
                int[] cost := [costs[lhs][0] + score.length, costs[lhs][1] + 1]
                key := [production.number, position]
                if costs[index][0] < 0 or less(cost, costs[index]) or (cost == costs[index] and less(key, parents[index][0:<2]))
                    costs[index] = cost
                    parents[index] = [production.number, position, lhs]
                    changed = true
    string[][] prefixes := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then []]
    string[][] suffixes := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then []]
    ready := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then i == start]
    bodies := [for production := productions[] then production.rhs]
    for: index < int(#source.order)
        build_context(index, source.order, parents, bodies, sentences, &prefixes, &suffixes, &ready)
    return Contexts(prefixes, suffixes)
string[] sets_report(syntax.Grammar source, analysis.Sets values, string[][] sentences)
    result := ["passes: nullable={values.passes[0]} first={values.passes[1]} follow={values.passes[2]}", ""]
    for: lhs < int(#source.order)
        result = result.concat([
            source.order[lhs],
            "  nullable: {yes_no(values.nullable[lhs])}",
            joined("  first:", analysis.terminal_order(values.first[lhs])),
            joined("  follow:", analysis.terminal_order(values.follow[lhs])),
            joined("  shortest:", sentences[lhs]),
        ])
    return result

int[] first_path(int initial, string token, syntax.Grammar source, tables.Table parse_table, analysis.Sets values)
    count := int(#parse_table.productions)
    queue := [initial]
    visited := [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then i + 1 == initial]
    parents := [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then -1]
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#queue)
        current := queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for symbol := parse_table.productions[current - 1].rhs[]
            if symbol == token
                int[] path := []
                while current != initial
                    path = [current].concat(path)
                    current = parents[current - 1]
                return path
            if syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol)
                lhs := syntax.index_of(source.order, symbol)
                for production := parse_table.productions[]
                    int number := production.number
                    if production.lhs == lhs and not visited[number - 1]
                        visited[number - 1] = true
                        parents[number - 1] = current
                        queue = queue.append(number)
                if not values.nullable[lhs]
                    break
            else
                break
    return []

int[] follow_path(int initial, string token, syntax.Grammar source, tables.Table parse_table, analysis.Sets values)
    queue := [initial]
    visited := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then i == initial]
    int[][] paths := [for i := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then []]
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#queue)
        symbol := queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        if source.order[symbol] == source.start and token == "$"
            return paths[symbol]
        for production := parse_table.productions[]
            for: position < int(#production.rhs)
                if production.rhs[position] != source.order[symbol]
                    continue
                string[] suffix := production.rhs[position + 1:<int(#production.rhs)]
                more := analysis.sequence(suffix, source.order, values.nullable, values.first)
                path := paths[symbol].append(production.number)
                if syntax.index_of(more.first, token) >= 0
                    return path
                if more.nullable and not visited[production.lhs]
                    visited[production.lhs] = true
                    paths[production.lhs] = path
                    queue = queue.append(production.lhs)
    return []

string[] table_report(syntax.Grammar source, analysis.Sets values, tables.Table parse_table, int conflicts_before)
    result := ["== predict sets =="]
    for: i < int(#parse_table.productions)
        tables.Production production := parse_table.productions[i]
        result = result.append("{production.number}: {production.notation}").append(joined("  predict:", parse_table.predict[i]))
    result = result.append("").append("== parse table ==")
    columns := values.terminals.append("$")
    string[][] matrix := [[""].concat(columns)]
    for: lhs < int(#source.order)
        row := [source.order[lhs]]
        for: column < int(#columns)
            numbers := parse_table.cells[lhs][column]
            fields := [for number := numbers[] then "{number}"]
            row = row.append(if #fields == 0 then "." else fields.join("/"))
        matrix = matrix.append(row)
    widths := [for i := (0:<int(int(#columns) + 1))[] then 0]
    for row := matrix[]
        for: i < int(#row)
            if int(#row[i]) > widths[i]
                widths[i] = int(#row[i])
    for row := matrix[]
        string line := row[0] + " " * nat(widths[0] - int(#row[0]))
        for: 1 <= i < int(#row)
            line += "  " + " " * nat(widths[i] - int(#row[i])) + row[i]
        result = result.append(line)
    result = result.append("").append("== conflicts ==")
    if #parse_table.conflicts == 0
        result = result.append("none")
    for conflict := parse_table.conflicts[]
        lhs := source.order[conflict.lhs]
        token := columns[conflict.token]
        result = result.append("conflict {lhs} on {token}: {conflict.kind}, chosen {conflict.chosen}")
        for number := conflict.numbers[]
            index := syntax.index_of(parse_table.predict[number - 1], token)
            reason := parse_table.reasons[number - 1][index]
            path := if reason == "FIRST" then first_path(number, token, source, parse_table, values) else follow_path(conflict.lhs, token, source, parse_table, values)
            if #path > 0
                reason = joined(reason + " via", path)
            result = result.append("  {number}: {parse_table.productions[number - 1].notation} ({reason})")
    result = result.append("LL(1): {yes_no(#parse_table.conflicts == 0)}").append("conflicts before transformation: {conflicts_before}")
    return result

int compact_node(driver.Node[] tree, int index, driver.Node[] &result)
    original := tree[index]
    int[] children := []
    for child_index := original.children[]
        if tree[child_index].symbol == "%empty"
            continue
        compacted := compact_node(tree, child_index, &result)
        child := result[compacted]
        if syntax.is_nonterminal(child.symbol) and child.mark == "" and #child.children == 0
            continue
        if syntax.is_nonterminal(child.symbol) and child.symbol.contains("'") and child.mark == ""
            children = children.concat(child.children)
        else
            children = children.append(compacted)
    if #children == 1 and original.mark == ""
        return children[0]
    compacted := int(#result)
    result = result.append(driver.Node(original.symbol, original.mark, children))
    return compacted

string tree_label(driver.Node node)
    return if node.mark == "" then node.symbol else "{node.symbol} ({node.mark})"

void visit_tree(driver.Node[] tree, int index, string prefix, bool last, string[] &result)
    node := tree[index]
    branch := if last then "`-- " else "|-- "
    result = result.append(prefix + branch + tree_label(node))
    next_prefix := prefix + (if last then "    " else "|   ")
    for: i < int(#node.children)
        visit_tree(tree, node.children[i], next_prefix, i + 1 == int(#node.children), &result)

string[] tree_lines(driver.Node[] tree, int root)
    result := [tree_label(tree[root])]
    children := tree[root].children
    for: i < int(#children)
        visit_tree(tree, children[i], "", i + 1 == int(#children), &result)
    return result

string[] trace_lines(driver.Trace[] trace)
    string[][] rows := [["step", "stack", "input", "action"]]
    for row := trace[]
        rows = rows.append(["{row.step}", row.stack, row.input, row.action])
    widths := [0, 0, 0]
    for row := rows[]
        for: i < 3
            if int(#row[i]) > widths[i]
                widths[i] = int(#row[i])
    string[] result := []
    for row := rows[]
        line := ""
        for: i < 3
            line += row[i] + " " * nat(widths[i] - int(#row[i])) + "  "
        result = result.append(line + row[3])
    return result

string[] derivation(syntax.Grammar source, int[] numbers, tables.Production[] productions)
    symbols := [source.start]
    result := ["  {source.start}"]
    for number := numbers[]
        position := 0
        while not syntax.is_nonterminal(symbols[position])
            position += 1
        symbols = symbols[0:<position].concat(productions[number - 1].rhs).concat(symbols[position + 1:<int(#symbols)])
        result = result.append("  => {syntax.alternative(symbols)}")
    return result

class State(int number, int dot, int origin)

void add_state(State[][] &chart, distinct<string>[] &seen, int position, State item)
    key := "{item.number}:{item.dot}:{item.origin}"
    if not seen[position].has(key)
        .seen[position].add(key)
        chart[position] = chart[position].append(item)

bool language(syntax.Grammar source, string[] tokens)
    tables.Production[] productions := tables.number_productions(source.order, source.rules)
    string[] lhs_names := [""].concat([for production := productions[] then source.order[production.lhs]])
    string[][] bodies := [[source.start]]
    bodies = bodies.concat([for production := productions[] then production.rhs])
    by_lhs := [for lhs := (0:<int(#source.order))[] then [for production := productions[] if production.lhs == lhs then production.number]]
    State[][] chart := [for i := (0:<int(int(#tokens) + 1))[] then []]
    seen := [for i := (0:<int(int(#tokens) + 1))[] then distinct<string>()]
    add_state(&chart, &seen, 0, State(0, 0, 0))
    for: position < int(#tokens) + 1
        cursor := 0
        while cursor < int(#chart[position])
            item := chart[position][cursor]
            cursor += 1
            rhs := bodies[item.number]
            if item.dot == int(#rhs)
                prior := chart[item.origin]
                for waiting := prior[]
                    body := bodies[waiting.number]
                    if waiting.dot < int(#body) and body[waiting.dot] == lhs_names[item.number]
                        add_state(&chart, &seen, position, State(waiting.number, waiting.dot + 1, waiting.origin))
            else
                symbol := rhs[item.dot]
                if syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol)
                    lhs := syntax.index_of(source.order, symbol)
                    for number := by_lhs[lhs][]
                        add_state(&chart, &seen, position, State(number, 0, position))
                    completed := chart[position]
                    for candidate := completed[]
                        if lhs_names[candidate.number] == symbol and candidate.dot == int(#bodies[candidate.number]) and candidate.origin == position
                            add_state(&chart, &seen, position, State(item.number, item.dot + 1, item.origin))
                elif position < int(#tokens) and symbol == tokens[position]
                    add_state(&chart, &seen, position + 1, State(item.number, item.dot + 1, item.origin))
    return seen[int(#tokens)].has("0:1:0")

string event_error(driver.Event event, syntax.Grammar source, analysis.Sets values, tables.Table parse_table)
    token := event.token
    symbol := event.symbol
    unexpected := if token == "$" then "end of input" else "{DQ}{token}{DQ} at token {event.position}"
    expected := ""
    if syntax.is_nonterminal(symbol)
        lhs := syntax.index_of(source.order, symbol)
        columns := values.terminals.append("$")
        string[] names := []
        for: column < int(#columns)
            if parse_table.choices[lhs][column] > 0
                name := columns[column]
                names = names.append(if name == "$" then "$" else DQ + name + DQ)
        expected = names.join(" ")
    else
        expected = if symbol == "$" then "$" else DQ + symbol + DQ
    recovery := if event.kind == "skip" then "skipped {DQ}{token}{DQ}" elif event.kind == "pop" then "popped {symbol}" else "inserted {DQ}{symbol}{DQ}"
    return "step {event.step}: unexpected {unexpected}; expected {expected}; {recovery}"

class InputResult(driver.Parsed parsed, string[] original, string[] errors, int unknown, bool accepted, bool in_language)

InputResult parse_input(string[] tokens, syntax.Grammar source, syntax.Grammar cleaned, analysis.Sets values, tables.Table parse_table)
    string[] kept := []
    int[] positions := []
    string[] errors := []
    for: i < int(#tokens)
        if syntax.index_of(values.terminals, tokens[i]) >= 0
            kept = kept.append(tokens[i])
            positions = positions.append(i + 1)
        else
            errors = errors.append("unknown {DQ}{tokens[i]}{DQ} at token {i + 1}; removed")
    unknown := int(#errors)
    string[][] bodies := [for production := parse_table.productions[] then production.rhs]
    string[] notations := [for production := parse_table.productions[] then production.notation]
    parsed := driver.parse(kept, positions, source.start, source.order, values.terminals, parse_table.choices, values.follow, bodies, notations)
    for event := parsed.events[]
        errors = errors.append(event_error(event, source, values, parse_table))
    return InputResult(parsed, tokens, errors, unknown, #errors == 0, language(cleaned, tokens))

string[] one_parse(int number, InputResult input, syntax.Grammar source, tables.Table parse_table)
    parsed := input.parsed
    result := ["== input {number} ==", joined("tokens:", input.original)]
    result = result.concat(trace_lines(parsed.trace)).append(joined("left parse:", parsed.left_parse))
    result = result.append("stats: steps={#parsed.trace} predicts={parsed.counts[0]} matches={parsed.counts[1]} max_stack={parsed.counts[5]}")
    if #input.errors > 0
        result = result.append("errors:")
        result = result.concat([for message := input.errors[] then "  {message}"])
    result = result.append(if input.accepted then "result: accepted" else "result: rejected (errors: {#input.errors})")
    result = result.append("language: {yes_no(input.in_language)}")
    if input.accepted
        result = result.append("derivation:").concat(derivation(source, parsed.left_parse, parse_table.productions))
    result = result.append("tree:").concat(tree_lines(parsed.tree, 0)).append("compact tree:")
    driver.Node[] compacted := []
    root := compact_node(parsed.tree, 0, &compacted)
    return result.concat(tree_lines(compacted, root))

string[] parses_report(InputResult[] inputs, syntax.Grammar source, analysis.Sets values, tables.Table parse_table, string[][] sentences, Contexts context)
    string[] result := []
    accepted := 0
    in_language := 0
    int[] mismatches := []
    used := [for i := (0:<int(#parse_table.productions))[] then false]
    recovery := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    for: i < int(#inputs)
        input := inputs[i]
        result = result.concat(one_parse(i + 1, input, source, parse_table)).append("")
        if input.accepted
            accepted += 1
        if input.in_language
            in_language += 1
        if input.accepted != input.in_language
            mismatches = mismatches.append(i + 1)
        recovery[0] += input.unknown
        for: k < 3
            recovery[k + 1] += input.parsed.counts[k + 2]
        for number := input.parsed.left_parse[]
            used[number - 1] = true
    unused := [for i := (0:<int(#used))[] if not used[i] then i + 1]
    result = result.concat([
        "== summary ==",
        "inputs={#inputs} accepted={accepted} rejected={int(#inputs) - accepted} in_language={in_language}",
        joined("mismatches:", mismatches),
        "recovery: unknown={recovery[0]} skip={recovery[1]} pop={recovery[2]} missing={recovery[3]}",
        "coverage: {int(#used) - int(#unused)} of {#used} productions used",
        joined("unused:", unused),
    ])
    string[][] bodies := [for production := parse_table.productions[] then production.rhs]
    string[] notations := [for production := parse_table.productions[] then production.notation]
    for number := unused[]
        tables.Production production := parse_table.productions[number - 1]
        string[] example := context.prefixes[production.lhs].concat(sentence(production.rhs, source.order, sentences)).concat(context.suffixes[production.lhs])
        positions := [for i := (0:<int(#example))[] then i + 1]
        parsed := driver.parse(example, positions, source.start, source.order, values.terminals, parse_table.choices, values.follow, bodies, notations)
        status := if #parsed.events == 0 then "    result: accepted" else "    result: rejected (errors: {#parsed.events})"
        result = result.concat([
            "  {number}: {production.notation}",
            joined("    example:", example),
            status,
            "    used: {yes_no(syntax.index_of(parsed.left_parse, number) >= 0)}",
        ])
    return result

void save(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

void run()
    source := syntax.parse(read_lines("input/grammar.bnf"))
    declaration_diagnostics := check_declarations(source)
    cleaned := clean(source.grammar)
    recursion_diagnostics := left_recursion(cleaned.model)
    recursion_result := transform.eliminate(cleaned.model.order, cleaned.model.rules)
    recursion := syntax.Grammar(recursion_result.order, recursion_result.rules, cleaned.model.start)
    factor_result := transform.factor(recursion.order, recursion.rules)
    factored := syntax.Grammar(factor_result.order, factor_result.rules, recursion.start)
    final_result := prune(factored)
    final := final_result.model
    before_sets := analysis.analyze(cleaned.model.order, cleaned.model.rules, cleaned.model.start)
    before_table := tables.build(cleaned.model.order, cleaned.model.rules, before_sets.nullable, before_sets.first, before_sets.follow, before_sets.terminals)
    values := analysis.analyze(final.order, final.rules, final.start)
    parse_table := tables.build(final.order, final.rules, values.nullable, values.first, values.follow, values.terminals)
    shortest_result := shortest(final)
    context := contexts(final, shortest_result.scores, shortest_result.sentences, parse_table.productions)
    InputResult[] inputs := []
    for line := read_lines("input/inputs.txt")[]
        string[] tokens := if #line == 0 then [] else line.split(" ")
        inputs = inputs.append(parse_input(tokens, final, cleaned.model, values, parse_table))
    string[] diagnostics := source.diagnostics.concat(declaration_diagnostics).concat(cleaned.diagnostics).concat(recursion_diagnostics).concat(final_result.diagnostics).concat(unused_declarations(source, final))
    diagnostics = diagnostics.append(if #parse_table.conflicts == 0 then "result: LL(1)" else "result: not LL(1) (conflicts: {#parse_table.conflicts})")
    save("grammar.txt", grammar_report(cleaned.model, recursion, factored, final, recursion_result.log, factor_result.log, final_result.log))
    save("sets.txt", sets_report(final, values, shortest_result.sentences))
    save("table.txt", table_report(final, values, parse_table, int(#before_table.conflicts)))
    save("parses.txt", parses_report(inputs, final, values, parse_table, shortest_result.sentences, context))
    save("diagnostics.txt", diagnostics)

run()

import syntax = "./grammar_parser.qui"

class Result(string[] order, string[][][] rules, string[] log)

string fresh(string[] order, string name)
    while true
        name = name[0:<int(#name) - 1] + "'>"
        if syntax.index_of(order, name) < 0
            return name

bool leading_reachable(string[] order, string[][][] rules, string start, string target)
    initial := syntax.index_of(order, start)
    queue := [initial]
    visited := [for i := (0:<int(#order))[] then i == initial]
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#queue)
        lhs := queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for rhs := rules[lhs][]
            if #rhs == 0
                continue
            symbol := rhs[0]
            if symbol == target
                return true
            next := syntax.index_of(order, symbol)
            if next >= 0 and not visited[next]
                visited[next] = true
                queue = queue.append(next)
    return false

string[][] unique(string[][] values)
    string[][] result := []
    for rhs := values[]
        if syntax.index_of(result, rhs) < 0
            result = result.append(rhs)
    return result

Result eliminate(string[] source_order, string[][][] source_rules)
    order := source_order
    rules := source_rules
    string[] log := []
    for: original < int(#source_order)
        lhs_name := source_order[original]
        for: earlier < original
            lhs := syntax.index_of(order, lhs_name)
            other := source_order[earlier]
            starts := false
            for rhs := rules[lhs][]
                if #rhs > 0 and rhs[0] == other
                    starts = true
                    break
            if starts and leading_reachable(order, rules, other, lhs_name)
                string[][] replaced := []
                other_index := syntax.index_of(order, other)
                for rhs := rules[lhs][]
                    if #rhs > 0 and rhs[0] == other
                        for alternative := rules[other_index][]
                            replaced = replaced.append(alternative.concat(rhs[1:<int(#rhs)]))
                    else
                        replaced = replaced.append(rhs)
                rules[lhs] = unique(replaced)
                log = log.append("substitute {other} into {lhs_name}")
        lhs := syntax.index_of(order, lhs_name)
        string[][] retained := []
        string[][] recursive := []
        string[][] ordinary := []
        for rhs := rules[lhs][]
            if #rhs == 1 and rhs[0] == lhs_name
                log = log.append("remove cycle {lhs_name} -> {lhs_name}")
            else
                retained = retained.append(rhs)
                if #rhs > 0 and rhs[0] == lhs_name
                    recursive = recursive.append(rhs[1:<int(#rhs)])
                else
                    ordinary = ordinary.append(rhs)
        if #recursive > 0
            name := fresh(order, lhs_name)
            rules[lhs] = [for rhs := ordinary[] then rhs.append(name)]
            tails := [for rhs := recursive[] then rhs.append(name)]
            tails = tails.append([])
            order = order[0:<lhs + 1].append(name).concat(order[lhs + 1:<int(#order)])
            rules = rules[0:<lhs + 1].append(tails).concat(rules[lhs + 1:<int(#rules)])
            log = log.append("eliminate left recursion in {lhs_name} with {name}")
        else
            rules[lhs] = retained
    return Result(order, rules, log)

Result factor(string[] source_order, string[][][] source_rules)
    order := source_order
    rules := source_rules
    string[] log := []
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#order)
        lhs_name := order[cursor]
        string[][] alternatives := []
        string[] seen := []
        string[] created := []
        string[][][] created_rules := []
        for rhs := rules[cursor][]
            if #rhs == 0
                alternatives = alternatives.append(rhs)
                continue
            first := rhs[0]
            if syntax.index_of(seen, first) >= 0
                continue
            seen = seen.append(first)
            group := [for member := rules[cursor][] if #member > 0 and member[0] == first then member]
            if #group == 1
                alternatives = alternatives.append(rhs)
                continue
            length := int(#rhs)
            for member := group[]
                if int(#member) < length
                    length = int(#member)
                matching := 0
                while matching < length and rhs[matching] == member[matching]
                    matching += 1
                length = matching
            name := fresh(order.concat(created), lhs_name)
            prefix := rhs[0:<length]
            alternatives = alternatives.append(prefix.append(name))
            created = created.append(name)
            created_rules = created_rules.append([for member := group[] then member[length:<int(#member)]])
            log = log.append("left factor {lhs_name} on {syntax.alternative(prefix)} with {name}")
        rules[cursor] = alternatives
        order = order[0:<cursor + 1].concat(created).concat(order[cursor + 1:<int(#order)])
        rules = rules[0:<cursor + 1].concat(created_rules).concat(rules[cursor + 1:<int(#rules)])
        cursor += 1
    return Result(order, rules, log)
